svg.text: 192 surrounding trees • leafy underlay • scenery remains outside the arena
Top-down placement diagram; lighting and appearance must be viewed in Roblox Studio.
Dashed square = 800 × 800 stud playable bounds. All forest geometry lies outside it.
Trees, vines, and leaf litter are decorative: collision, touch, and queries are disabled.
